metadata.description: Skills distilled from 32 screenwriting / television / dramaturgy books plus 12 volumes of published scripts and plays (Chekhov, Ozu, Succession, The West Wing, The Sopranos, Downton Abbey, Fleabag and more), covering features, TV series and the stage

plugins.name: screenwriting
plugins.description: 21 skills in four layers: general dramaturgy (workflow & story bible, structure, premise & theme, character & conflict, dialogue, scene craft, format & adaptation); the medium layer (series: episode & season structure, series engine & bible, writers' room, half-hour comedy; stage: Chinese opera, banqiang system, lyric method and medium boundary); tradition & trade (American case studies, Japanese, Korean & French, mainland-Chinese series practice, industry & business); and master corpora (Chekhov dramaturgy, Ozu screenplay style, Succession ensemble writing, television case studies); answers in the language you ask in (one Chinese source tree, no per-language forks)
